scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n web,server,worker "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/worker"
scripts.dev:no-worker: npx concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.lint: eslint packages apps/web/src/magazine-builder apps/server/src/routes/magazineBuilder apps/server/src/lib/magazineBuilder apps/worker/src/jobs/publishMagazine.ts --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --max-warnings=0
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:apps && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:apps: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
